Principle 10: What Do I Do during the Week?
I would like to tell you about my weekday schedule.
My weekly schedule is just as busy as my daily one.
Each day is busier than the one before.
For me, it is very hard to get out of bed every Monday morning.
When my mother shouts at me to wake up, I don’t want to get up.
I want to stay in bed longer, and after a few minutes,
I finally get out of bed.
After I get up and prepare for school,
the first day of my new week has started on this note.
My weekday is similar to the other students in my class.
From Monday to Friday,
I go to school for about seven hours and after school,
I go to academies for several more hours.
Even after I come home,
I study for a couple more hours before going to sleep.
Sometimes, I feel like I study too much, and it is too hard.
Even though it is hard work,
I am happy to learn new things and spend time with my friends.
Every night when I get home, I chat on the computer with my friends.
Nowadays, I am on the computer for a couple of hours every day.
It is a great way to talk to my friends about what we did during the day.
I exchange information about our homework, about other friends
and what is going on in the entertainment scene in Korea.
Also, I often do my homework on the computer.
Sometimes I watch TV or listen to music before I go to bed.
My favorite time is Friday night because it is the start of the weekend.
It is the end of normal schedule of school and academies.
I can reflect on things that did not go well
and hopefully plan a better new week.
Before I do this, I start thinking about the fun things
that I have planned for the upcoming weekend.
